csv_project_name: Consultant for Alaska Corrosion Control Study
csv_scope_of_work: The Alaska Aerospace Corporation (AAC) is seeking a qualified Contractor to conduct a comprehensive Corrosion Control Study for the Launch Tower at LP-1 and associated support equipment at the Pacific Spaceport Complex-Alaska (PSCA) in Kodiak, AK. The primary objective is to assess the current material condition of all surfaces and structural components. The Contractor will utilize non-destructive evaluation (NDE) methods to identify degradation and provide a detailed technical report to guide future maintenance and life-extension efforts for the facility.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Materials Testing, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
